name: After § 11
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 11a. Stresses that the EU’s political and diplomatic efforts have hitherto been focused almost exclusively on its eastern border, thereby increasing the risk of direct confrontation with the Russian Federation; believes that such an imbalanced approach undermines the broader interests and security of the majority of Member States; emphasises the need for a balanced and comprehensive assessment of the EU’s geopolitical challenges; calls for the strategic importance of the Mediterranean – which has been unduly relegated to a secondary role – to be restored to the core of the EU’s external action; urges the Commission and the Council to promptly re-establish equilibrium within the EU’s strategic priorities, ensuring that equal and coherent attention is devoted to both the eastern and southern dimensions of its foreign and security policy;
